item.description: Base 0.4.5. Notes fixes: ink written just before leaving the app is saved, fast writing reaches autosave within a second, and Back waits for the save and says when it fails. A page whose ink cannot be loaded is read-only instead of being overwritten, and repeated partial erases are saved. Imported notes keep Notability recognized text; handwriting added in Base is appended. Pencil double-tap works again and the double squeeze is detected more reliably. Template Settings: spacing starts at 12 pt and no longer resizes pages by accident. Long notes stutter less after each stroke and import is about twice as fast. Sync and Hand Off are protected against overwrites, stale deletions and shell targets.

Base 0.4.4: pinch below page width without snapping back. Hold Apple Pencil Pro squeeze to erase and release to restore your tool; two quick squeezes toggle it persistently. More > Template Settings previews paper, ruling, spacing, colour, size and orientation before Apply, with named My Templates and a per-page option. A resize cannot crop existing ink or pictures. Coloured notes require an updated daemon to sync.
Base 0.4.3. Fixes a crash that could close the app a few seconds after launch: a live connection to a host that was restarted while it was still opening could abort the app.

Base 0.4.2. Notes: import a Notability note with every stroke as real ink, its shapes, photos, recognized text, page size and ruling (library Import action, or put the .nbn folder into Documents/Notability Import). The note screen is rebuilt after Notability: its own toolbox with pen, pencil, highlighter, eraser, text, select, add, dictate and finger drawing, per-tool colours, thickness and favourites, all pages in one scrolling document, a page manager, and dark paper in dark mode. PDFs under the ink are not imported yet.

Base 0.4.1. Notes sync and handoff are offered only on hosts running Base 0.4 or later, and the app says so in plain words when no connected host is. Fixes the "Method Not Allowed" shown when a note was handed to an older host.

Base 0.4.0. Notes: handwritten and typed notes on iPad, synced to a Base daemon and handed to an agent session. Spoken replies: a reply is read aloud when its message was dictated, through Zonos on hosts that have it and with the device voice elsewhere. Backing-store status in Settings. Notes sync, handoff and Zonos need a 0.4 daemon; with an older daemon notes stay on the device.

Replaces verbose submitted/awaiting-confirmation labels with WhatsApp-style delivery indicators at the bottom-right of outgoing messages: a clock while sending, one check after host submission, and two accent-colored checks after agent confirmation. Confirmed history keeps the double checks. Hover/accessibility labels expose status, and clicking an unresolved check only refreshes receipts. Failure details and safe retry controls remain available. Existing receipt authority, replay protections, password-free policy, and session-kill fixes are unchanged. Sparkle installs Base.app only; providers, daemon, runners, windows, Spaces, and drafts are preserved. iOS feed unchanged.

Fixes session termination when a stale native chat remains visible after its runtime disappears. Native Kill checks the exact host and conversation, uses the native stop route, and reconciles failed stops before clearing a row; a missing runner alone never counts as successful termination. Already-gone legacy targets are handled idempotently after authoritative enumeration. History, drafts, neighboring sessions, network gates, and agent permissions are preserved. Includes the password-free local authorization and compact-sidebar corrections. Sparkle installs Base.app only; runtime binaries are separate assets.

Removes automatic Base credential prompts. The Mac app once configures its existing private local runtime for trusted-network native actions without restarting the daemon or agent sessions. Keychain reads cannot authenticate interactively; CLI commands no longer collect passwords from the terminal. Network/origin checks and scoped-agent permissions remain enforced. Deliberately strict runtime administration retains explicit credential-fd support. Sparkle installs Base.app only; CLI, daemon, and runner binaries are separate assets.

Removes the history control entirely from the compact sidebar, with no replacement icon, label, or reserved space. This update installs only Base.app; daemon, CLI, native runners, and the iOS feed are unchanged.
